namespaces.name: Desktop
namespaces.documentation: Native windows, input, timing, software framebuffer, sprites, soft text, sprite batching, and OpenGL GPU.

types.name: Desktop.Window
types.documentation: Managed Win32/X11 window. Native declarations are supplied by the plugin; scope exit releases the handle automatically.
types.ownership: Managed RAII owner; native handle is released automatically.

members.name: poll
members.documentation: Processes pending OS events and returns whether the window remains open.

members.name: close
members.documentation: Optional early close. Normal scope exit releases the native handle automatically.

types.name: Desktop.Font
types.documentation: RAII soft TrueType/system font (Windows GDI). Scope exit releases it automatically.
types.snippet:
auto ${1:font} = new Desktop.Font(${2:"Segoe UI"}, ${3:18}, Desktop.Font.StyleNormal);
$4.drawFontText($1, ${5:16}, ${6:16}, ${7:"Hello"}, Desktop.rgb(255,255,255));

types.name: Desktop.Audio
types.documentation: RAII WAV software mixer (Windows waveOut). loadWav, master volume, stopAll.
types.ownership: Managed RAII owner; loaded Sound objects must not outlive this Audio device.

types.documentation: RAII decoded WAV clip. play(volume), playLoop(volume), stop.
types.ownership: Managed RAII owner returned by Audio.loadWav.

types.name: Desktop.Gpu
types.documentation: RAII multi-backend RHI. Managed GPU resources are released automatically in reverse scope order.
types.ownership: Managed RAII owner; declare child GPU resources after the device.

members.name: supportsCompute
members.documentation: True when the selected backend implements compute shaders (currently D3D11).
